items.title: Malicious Webpage Could Steal Meta Muse Chats, Researchers Say - UrduPoint
items.zh_title: 恶意网页或可窃取 Meta Muse 聊天内容，研究人员发出警告
items.zh_oneliner: 研究人员发现，恶意网页可能利用漏洞窃取用户与 Meta Muse 的聊天记录，提醒用户留意相关风险。
items.en_oneliner: Researchers found that a malicious webpage could exploit a vulnerability to steal users' chat history with Meta Muse, and warned users to watch out for the risk.
items.reason_en: Published within 6 hours · Related to this topic

items.title: 'This seems like an extreme privacy violation.' Surprising messages from the Muse AI agent are unnerving Meta's own employees, report says - Fortune
items.zh_title: “这似乎是极端的隐私侵犯”：Muse AI 智能体的惊人消息让 Meta 自家员工感到不安
items.zh_oneliner: 报道称，Muse AI 智能体向用户发送的出人意料的消息，引发了 Meta 内部员工对隐私的担忧。
items.en_oneliner: A report says surprising messages sent by the Muse AI agent have raised privacy concerns among Meta's own employees.
items.source: Google 新闻：Muse Meta AI（英文）
